do_not_use_when: MadAnalysis 5 delivery: use ma5-pad or ma5-saf.

examples.phrase: Run supplied HepMC2 events through a source-bound CheckMATE configuration.

use_when: Supplied HepMC2 events must be run through CheckMATE to obtain signal-region tables.
A CheckMATE-implemented search is the reinterpretation target.
